name: God And Jesus
overview: The Scriptures reveal the profound unity and distinction between God and Jesus, affirming Jesus as both divine and the means of eternal life. John 1:1 establishes that Jesus, the Word, was with God in the beginning and is Himself God. Jesus’ declaration in John 8:58, "Before Abraham was, I am," echoes the divine name, underscoring His eternal nature. Furthermore, Jesus affirms in John 14:6 that He is the exclusive way to the Father, and John 17:3 highlights that eternal life comes through knowing the only true God and Jesus Christ whom God sent.
